g.text: Hint error is not a monotonic measure of placement quality
Untouched final holdout: seeds 301–305; 14 error rates; 50,000 host writes/run; 2,048 logical pages.
B=512, K=2 frozen before final evaluation. Curves connect tested rates; ranges are descriptive, not confidence intervals.
Offline |phi| is explanatory evidence, not the causal online detector input. Synthetic symmetric model; no real FDP/hardware claim.
